title: A face is just a face.
intro: Your character is cosmetic. Your secret role decides your side and abilities. These are the possible roles, not a reveal of who has them. Classic preserves the familiar lineup; its Illusions variant adds haunting and forged readings. Hard introduces Tracker and Herbalist alongside more deceptive roles. Chaos draws a fresh cast with possible duplicates. Paranoia keeps the dealt role counts secret and lets anyone make a public oath. Custom uses the host’s exact role counts. Check the room’s Modes settings for your gathering.
